column1: # OPTIONAL. Per-CONFIGURATION facts - anything that differs by engine x gearbox x drivetrain x body.

# configs-*.csv grid: phase_label + the same column header (BODY|GEARBOX|DRIVETRAIN) + engine_code
# + power_kw. Leave the file with just its header when there is nothing per configuration.
# Empty cell = genuinely unknown (NULL) - never estimate consumption
#   fuel_consumption_l100km     official combined figure for the PRIMARY fuel (= the engine's
#                               fuel_type; the LPG/CNG figure on a factory LPG/CNG car)
#   consumption_cycle           NEDC | WLTP - blank = the phase's default from phases.csv
#   secondary_fuel_type         petrol | lpg | cng - bi-fuel cars only
#   secondary_consumption_l100km  the second fuel's official figure (both or neither)
#   towing_braked_kg / towing_unbraked_kg   homologated trailer limits (unbraked <= braked)
#   curb_weight_kg              this configuration's own weight (dimensions.csv holds the base)
#   ev_range_km            electric range of this configuration (battery / charging / heat
#                               pump are ENGINE columns - see engines.csv)
